narrative.summary: BioGraph Steward connects scoped questions to Pharos-based evidence graphs, cited answers and auditable exports. The core workflow now includes reproducible biological assessment; independent predictive benefit and user validation remain in progress.
accomplishments: Built a guided Pharos/CIViC workbench with source inspection, review of proposed changes and exports preserving the full graph, original evidence and edge decisions.

Integrated IntAct/IMEx using the official JAMI reader and PSI-MI vocabulary. Development checks preserve identities, assay context and references through answers and exports. The reserved assessment identified a comparator limitation for structural identifiers.

Connected NVIDIA Nemotron through vLLM with explicit scope checks and plan review. Live guided assessment still found unreliable model task selection; verified deterministic construction remains the working path.

Completed reproducible PyKEEN R-GCN assessment against 1,751 experimentally tested protein pairs. Adding Reactome memberships gave a small mean average precision increase (0.7178 to 0.7196), with mixed seed effects.

Published qualified assay observations, including nondetections. MIT-licensed code passes clean local installation and real-data replay through cited answers and verified browser downloads. Assisted user feedback improved export guidance.
blockers: Consistent predictive gain remains unproven. The assay panel was reused for development, Pharos postdates the assays, and source overlap remains uncertain.

The reserved source-fidelity run exposed a comparator error involving structural identifiers. Its correction passed a separate development check on saved records; the original run stays unscored. A fresh reference and independent user walkthrough remain next.
Clarification of the organizer baseline, scoring and submission format will guide final packaging. Brev compute and AWS credits are available; infrastructure access is not currently a blocker.
milestones: Integrate the documented identifier comparison, qualify a fresh reference and complete study-level provenance checks; incorporate organizer scoring requirements when clarified.
Assess preservation of curated evidence under frozen rules and documented overlap exclusions; run an independent colleague walkthrough when available.
Publish the verified installation and real-data demonstration with source manifests and evaluation results; deploy on AWS if shared hosting is required.
